title: Pearlmoor Quay - Low Tide, Lantern Strings
_note: Mood sibling, melancholy. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 92 BPM, 3/4, D minor (relative minor of the anchor's F). Same waltz line, slower and bare - the accordion lilt now a lonely sway. Waltz contour in minor, the lift hesitant - sibling sadness to Tinderwick B and Dimglass B (the south's wistful blue-hour family). Harmony = sparse bell-buoy chimes ringing into the gaps. Bass = slower rocking waltz bass, deeper, like a tide gone out. Percussion = none (the creak of empty boards implied by space). 24-bar loop ~47s.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Waltz contour in D minor, lift hesitant (A3->D4->E4 ... F4->E4->D4 settle). Slower, barer, more rests. Final bar leans on A (V of Dm) into bar 1.
